module_summary: 8x1 memory: an enabled 8-bit shift register is written serially from S and read randomly via an 8:1 mux addressed by {A,B,C}.

anchors.name: q
anchors.why: 8-bit shift register acting as 8x1 memory, shifted from S.

anchors.name: Z
anchors.why: Read data: bit of q selected by the {A,B,C} mux.

anchors.name: enable
anchors.why: Synchronous shift enable gating writes into q.

anchors.name: A
anchors.why: Read address MSB selecting a bit of q.

anchors.name: B
anchors.why: Read address middle bit selecting a bit of q.

anchors.name: C
anchors.why: Read address LSB selecting a bit of q.

anchors.name: S
anchors.why: Serial write data shifted into q[0].
